achievements.name: Thrown in the Deep End
achievements.description: Complete your first shift on patrol.

achievements.name: Cleaning the Streets
achievements.description: Take down the August Gang (their storyline becomes a priority on your third day).

achievements.name: Building a Case
achievements.description: Submit 5 pieces of evidence against gangs.

achievements.name: Big Trouble in Chinatown
achievements.description: Take down the Crimson Serpents gang and complete their storyline.

achievements.name: Unlucky, Punk
achievements.description: Take down the Jawheads gang and complete their storyline.

achievements.name: Partner in Law
achievements.description: Reach the story beat where Kelly saves you from Warehouse 6 (unlocks automatically near the end of the main story).

achievements.name: The Secrets of the ACPD
achievements.description: Complete the main story.

achievements.name: Ruined Their Day
achievements.description: Issue 3 valid parking violation tickets.

achievements.name: The Most Hated Person in Averno City
achievements.description: Issue 50 valid parking violation tickets.

achievements.name: Fine Work
achievements.description: Issue 10 valid parking violation tickets in one shift.

achievements.name: Book 'Em, Cordell

achievements.name: There's Gonna Be a Lot of Paperwork
achievements.description: Arrest 100 suspects.

achievements.description: Have two suspects from different crimes in your police car at the same time.

achievements.name: Track Star
achievements.description: Sprint for 30 seconds without stopping.

achievements.name: Self Improvement
achievements.description: Unlock a Player Upgrade.

achievements.name: Maxed Out
achievements.description: Unlock every Player Upgrade in a category.

achievements.name: Making Your Mark
achievements.description: Achieve the rank of Police Officer 1.

achievements.name: A Promising Career
achievements.description: Reach the maximum Police Rank.

achievements.name: What's in the Box?
achievements.description: Recover an artifact.

achievements.name: A Sharp Mind
achievements.description: Recover every artifact.

achievements.name: Taking Out the Trash
achievements.description: Commandeer a Garbage Truck.

achievements.name: We'll Pay for the Damage

achievements.name: We're Gonna Need a Bigger Holding Cell
achievements.description: Book 6 criminals in one shift.

achievements.name: Is It a Bird?
achievements.description: Complete 5 vehicle jumps.

achievements.name: No, It's the Law

achievements.name: Employee of the Day
achievements.description: Earn 10,000 XP in a single shift.

achievements.name: Historian
achievements.description: Read every Plaque.

achievements.description: Help ground officers arrest 20 suspects while you're in the helicopter.

achievements.name: Radio Responder

achievements.description: Complete a time trial.

achievements.name: Pedal to the Metal

achievements.name: Fast Responder

achievements.name: Coming in Clutch

achievements.name: I'm Fast, I'm Very Fast
achievements.description: Finish in 1st place in all Street Races.

achievements.name: Nowhere to hide

achievements.name: Clean Slate
achievements.description: Flush every toilet in The Precinct.

achievements.name: Career Limiting Move
achievements.description: Park in the Chief's Space.

achievements.name: Hidden in the Hood
achievements.description: Discover and drive all the rare vehicles.

achievements.name: On Top Form
achievements.description: Achieve first place on the Shift scoreboard.
